details: Mental health research with the Directorate General of Medical Education, led by Naimul and Abir. The folder holds the DGME research protocol, the baseline multi-centre cross-sectional study on prevalence and psychosocial correlates among Bangladeshi university students, and the explainable multimodal AI-based early risk assessment platform. IRB and ERB approvals, budgets, CVs, NIDs and participant lists are filed alongside the data folders.
